subject: Cast int64 literals to double in jsonutil_is_int64 tests (#99)
reason: The change edits only a unit-test file (tst/unit/util_test.cc), adding explicit static_cast<double> to two int64 literals passed to jsonutil_is_int64(double). The implicit conversion already occurred at those call sites, so this only silences a compiler warning in the test build; no module source, command behavior, reply, or data path changes, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
